WARDOGS Helicopter Controls

A WARDOGS helicopter controls page structure for vehicle controls, input setup, and HOTAS-related verification.

Target keyword
wardogs helicopter controls
Priority
P1
Manual review
high

Quick Answer

Officially confirmed: WARDOGS includes vehicles and flyable aircraft, and Team17 specifically describes using a helicopter to ferry supplies to teammates.

BULKHEAD has not published a complete official helicopter control map at the time of writing.

Do not assume default helicopter controls such as throttle, yaw, pitch, mouse steering, or controller bindings until the current in-game controls menu is verified.

Needs Manual Review

Pre-release / Early Access sensitive: This is pre-release / Early Access sensitive content. Current details will be verified against the latest official build before publication.

Are Helicopters Officially in WARDOGS?

  • Officially confirmed:The Steam developer FAQ says WARDOGS includes drivable vehicles and flyable aircraft.
  • Officially confirmed:Team17 describes players ferrying supplies to teammates by helicopter.
  • Officially confirmed:The WARDOGS Supporter Pack includes a Littlebird Helicopter Taxi Camo, confirming helicopter-related cosmetic content.

Official Control Information

  • Not officially confirmed:BULKHEAD has not published a complete official helicopter control map at the time of writing.
  • Not officially confirmed:No official source checked here confirms default helicopter keyboard, mouse, controller, or HOTAS bindings.
  • Officially confirmed:The developer FAQ says HOTAS support is not available now and is not a priority, though it is in the development pipeline.

How to Check Your Current Controls

  • General guidance:Open the current in-game Settings or Controls menu and record the bindings shown there before publishing any helicopter-control guide.
  • General guidance:Check whether helicopter controls are listed separately from infantry, vehicle, controller, and accessibility settings.
  • General guidance:If a binding is missing or behaves differently from beta reports, treat the live build as the source of truth.

Community-reported Handling

  • Community-reported:Steam community discussions include questions and feedback about aircraft handling, mouse flight, and HOTAS or TrackIR-style support.
  • Community-reported:These reports help identify what players are testing, but they do not establish official default controls.

What Not to Publish Yet

  • Do not publish default throttle, yaw, pitch, roll, landing, camera, weapon, or seat-switch bindings without verification.
  • Do not state that HOTAS or flight sticks are supported in the current build unless official notes or direct testing confirms it.
  • Do not copy beta-era aircraft handling reports into an Early Access guide without checking the live controls menu.
